settings._title: What counts as a piece of feedback?

settings.editor: One ticket, survey answer, review, chat or call transcript. Replies in the same ticket count once.

settings._title: What happens if we go over our limit?

settings.editor: Nothing breaks. We keep collecting and let you know, and you can move up a step or wait for next month.
Yes, at any time. Upgrades apply straight away; downgrades apply at the end of your billing period.

settings._title: Do you offer discounts for nonprofits and startups?

settings.editor: Yes: 50% off for registered nonprofits, and our startup programme gives a year of Growth at Starter prices.

settings._title: Which payment methods do you accept?

settings.editor: All major cards. Yearly plans can also pay by bank transfer against an invoice.
